entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Reduce repeated targeting-pack conflict parsing allocations in ResolvePackageFileConflicts #55956
  • Designer shadow-copy leak when multi-targeting .NET Framework and modern frameworks #55954
  • CA1815 should not report on union declarations #55949
  • TypeScript static web asset registration duplicates retained generated outputs after obj cleanup #55945
  • [[NETSDKE2E]][openSUSE]With .NET 10.0.401, running dnx returns /usr/bin/dnx: line 1: ../share/dotnet/dnx: No such file or directory on openSUSE #55935
  • Subject: MSBuild's Indiscriminate Retry on Permanent File Locks Causes Unnecessary Build Time Waste #55933

Closed

  • Build all projects for target architecture - remove all `AnyCpu` usage #53368
  • Need to address SDK folder location with AOT #52987
  • Create end to end test(s) that invokes AOT'd application instead of managed application #53243
  • Set up pipeline to create AOT'd CLI application and get in SDK layout #53242
  • `dotnet test` for MTP should support post-processing of artifacts #47613
  • Clarify intent of Microsoft.Win32.Msi.Manual.Tests: real test project (migrate to MTP) or standalone tool (exclude from CI)? #55132
  • RZ2009 is raised whenever a comment is put inside a [RestrictChildren] tag #55745

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/11.0.1xx-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55957
  • Fix designer shadow-copy leak for net48 builds #55955
  • [release/9.0.1xx] Disable network isolation on internal PR builds; enforce CFSClean3 on official #55953
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • Use system access token for internal feeds #55952
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • Avoid duplicate TypeScript static web assets #55951
  • Do not report CA1815 on union declarations #55950
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Allow passing per-client updates #55948
    backport
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Do not set DotNetWatchBuild in design-time build in Hot Reload mode #55947
    backport
  • Parallelize ApiDiff unit tests #55944
  • Parallelize ApiCompat unit tests #55943
  • Enable parallel TemplateEngine core unit tests #55942
  • Parallelize runnable project orchestrator tests #55941
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Backport MTP diagnostics and --nologo support #55939
  • Use public Azure DevOps APIs for AOT size analysis #55938
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55934
  • Restore OneLocBuild check-in CI for release/11.0.1xx #55932
    Servicing-consider

Merged

  • Resolve analyzers from the analyzers group in project.assets.json #54646
  • Consolidate local test execution #55787
    Area-AIEngineering
  • Use versioned SDK directory for AOT forwarding apps #55923
    Area-dotnet AOT
  • Add code coverage artifact post-processing test #55940
  • Route vendored-sync drift issues to area triage via manifest-declared labels #55520
  • Reclassify Microsoft.Win32.Msi.Manual.Tests as a standalone manual tool #55272
  • Show dotnetup environment setup progress after installation #55796

Updated

  • [release/11.0.1xx] Fix dnx offline package cache fallback #55958
    Area-Tools
  • Skip full Build for AOT publish, use Compile instead #54515
    breaking-change
  • Fix concurrent tool installation race conditions with named mutex #51834
    stale
  • Use SDK directory for environment command search #55925
    Area-dotnet AOT
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55918
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55754
  • Stop promoting NU1605 to an error by default #55732
  • Guard Visual Studio resolver public APIs #55930
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Templates, Area-SdkResolvers, Area-Workloads, Area-ApiCompat
  • File-level directives: allow quoting and additional properties #55592
    Area-run-file
  • Bootstrap scoped agent knowledge for the SDK #55865
    Area-AIEngineering
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55765
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.4.0-preview.26409.6 to 4.4.0-preview.26411.1 #55768
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Bump Microsoft.WixToolset.Sdk from 6.0.3-dotnet.6 to 6.0.3-dotnet.14 #55767
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Fix hosted Blazor WASM HTML placeholder publishing #55907
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-WasmSdk
  • Suppress default values for .NET CLI flag options #55928
